scope: Claim-boundary audit for the active two-training-seed I0/I8 confirmation. This artifact does not change or authorize any active training, evaluation, allocation, gate, or controller action.

known: Complete seed-42 I0/I8 training and evaluation results.
All Phase-1 allocations were prepared once with complement_seed 42.
unobserved: All seed-43 I8 training and evaluation results.
Any I0/I8 result using a complement seed other than 42.

launcher.fixed_allocation_rule: All training seeds read METHOD-specific rank_map.json and subspaces.safetensors from the same PHASE1_ARTIFACT_ROOT.
launcher.training_seed_rule: TRAIN_SEED changes DATA_SEED, PPO_DATA_LOADER_SEED, and ROLLOUT_SEED only; it does not regenerate the allocation.

i0_seed43_prepared.mutable_note: This prepared contract will change when finalized with the step-50 adapter; its embedded allocation hashes are the relevant evidence here.

held_fixed_across_training_seeds: Rank maps and subspace tensor bytes
finding.formal_interpretation: The active seeds 42/43 experiment measures replication across two on-policy training trajectories under one fixed initialization draw. It does not measure robustness across random-complement or initialization seeds.

claim_policy.allowed_if_the_existing_two_seed_gate_pa: Use only the frozen fixed-model/task wording: the improvement replicated on one held-out training seed and was positive on both tested training seeds.
disallowed: The 24 random complement directions are generally beneficial.
Stable across training seeds, models, tasks, domains, or datasets.

future_decision_boundary.if_i8_is_the_paper_method: Initialization robustness requires fresh I0/I8 allocations with independently fixed complement seeds and matched training/evaluation protocols; changing TRAIN_SEED alone is insufficient.
future_decision_boundary.if_i32_is_later_confirmed: I32 has no random complement, so this specific robustness dimension is absent, but its post-selection Phase-1b status and fixed P2 discovery source must still be disclosed.
future_decision_boundary.priority: Complete the active two-seed gate and mandatory matched standard-LoRA baseline before spending compute on random-complement robustness. Do not reinterpret the current runs as covering that axis.
